# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: Labeling

> 2-hour online function-specific training for hazmat employers and employees who identify, select, replace and apply hazardous materials labels, under DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart E. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 3 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years, and when relevant regulations change)

## Topics
- General labeling requirements and exceptions
- Affixing primary and subsidiary hazard labels
- Label specifications: size, design, durability, color, form identification
- Label elements for hazard Classes 1 to 9 and divisions
- Radioactive material labels
- CARGO AIRCRAFT ONLY label

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. General Labeling Requirements
3. Specific Labeling Requirements

## Who should take it
Hazmat employers; shipping and receiving personnel; warehouse workers managing hazmat inventory; safety managers overseeing hazmat transportation.
